text.content:
Classification: Bloodline (Cappadocian-allied)

The first Lamia was, by bloodline legend, the daughter of Lilith and inheritor of the title "Lamia" — high priestess of the Dark Mother, passed matrilineally. She was forcibly Embraced by Lazarus of Clan Cappadocian, and Lilith herself is said to have instructed her to protect and guide the Cappadocians' studies. The Lamia (also called the Gorgons) share the Cappadocians' fascination with death, but seek its truths through sensation and experience rather than dusty tomes, exalting in vampirism as a gift of the Dark Mother. They serve as the Cappadocians' warriors and guardians, and their loyalty to Lilith is generally kept private (sometimes disguised beneath cults ostensibly devoted to the Virgin Mary) rather than secret, earning them a wary, middling respect among other Cainites.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Mortis (Path of Four Humours), Potence

Advantage: As warriors and guardians of the Cappadocians, all Lamia begin with two Traits chosen from Archery, Brawl, Dodge and Melee (two of one, or two different).

Disadvantage: Lamia carry the Seed of Lilith: anyone they feed upon must win a Static Physical Challenge (six Traits for women, eight for men) or contract a deadly plague-like sickness.

Organization: Closely bound to Clan Cappadocian as its protectors, close-knit and loyal to their own vision of the Dark Mother's plan.

Suggested Viae: All major roads are represented, though many follow the Cappadocians' Road of Bones.
